name: Prothrombin complex concentrate (PCC)
mechanism: Contains factors II, VII, IX, X (and variable protein C/S) to rapidly reverse vitamin K antagonists
dosing: Dose based on INR and weight per local guideline
contraindications: Known hypersensitivity to PCC components or heparin (depending on product formulation)
interactions: No routine drug interactions but concurrent prothrombotic states and certain factor products may increase thrombosis risk; follow local transfusion/haematology guidance
monitoring: Monitor INR, clinical haemostasis, and for thrombotic complications after administration; ensure vitamin K given where appropriate
pregnancy: Specialist use only with haematology/obstetric guidance
sideEffects: Potential thrombosis risk; allergic reactions or transfusion-related events may occur
clinicalPearls: Used alongside vitamin K to rapidly correct INR in major bleeding or when immediate reversal is needed for urgent surgery; dosing protocols vary by product and local guidelines
indication: Rapid reversal of vitamin K antagonist anticoagulation in major bleeding or prior to urgent procedures
